title: Horingar: Darkside
description:
Horingar: Darkside is a hand-drawn adult dark fantasy RPG featuring turn-based combat, choice-driven relationships, and a semi-open world..

You play as the prince of a fallen kingdom on the brink of collapse under relentless reparations. A mysterious note draws you beyond the castle walls, where power, loyalty, and desire intertwine. Your choices - both political and personal - will shape your relationships, your pleasures, and the fate of your kingdom.

Core Gameplay• Turn-Based Combat - Engage in strategic battles where equipment, abilities, and preparation matter.

• Multiple Playstyles - Overcome challenges through direct combat, stealth-based approaches, or puzzle-solving, each offering different outcomes and rewards.

• Semi-Open World Exploration - Travel between cities, ruins, wilderness zones, and hidden locations, uncovering side quests, secrets, and lore.

Character Progression• Talent System - Customize your party's growth through talents that shape each character's role.

• Professions & Crafting - Gather resources through activities like mining and herbalism, then craft equipment, consumables, and upgrades to support your preferred playstyle.

• Meaningful Choices - Decisions affect story progression, character relationships, available quests, and endings.

Relationships & Adult Content• Choice-Based Romance System - Build relationships through dialogue, actions, and trust.

• Adult Content - Features consensual, vanilla adult scenes with light harem elements, integrated naturally into character routes and story progression.

• Relationship Consequences - Romantic and personal choices influence alliances, loyalty, and narrative outcomes.

Visual & Narrative Style• Hand-drawn characters, scenes and environments

• Dark fantasy atmosphere with mature themes

• Multiple endings based on player choices

Play Prince Reiner as you fight, sneak, and solve puzzles, pursue erotic romances, and explore story driven sexual content that shapes power, pleasure, and the kingdom’s fate.
